presentations.name: Fé

presentations.name: Adoração

presentations.name: Worship
presentations.summary: Recognizing who God is and directing our lives toward serving him.

presentations.name: Jejum
presentations.summary: Abster-se de alimento como prática de busca de Deus, sem ostentação e junto à justiça.

presentations.name: Fasting
presentations.summary: Seeking God through abstaining from food, without display and alongside justice.

presentations.name: Obediência
presentations.summary: Ouvir a palavra de Deus e colocá-la em prática.

presentations.name: Obedience
presentations.summary: Listening to God's word and putting it into practice.

presentations.name: Gratidão
presentations.summary: Reconhecer as dádivas de Deus e cultivar ações de graças.

presentations.name: Gratitude
presentations.summary: Recognizing God's gifts and cultivating thanksgiving.

presentations.name: Confiança em Deus
presentations.summary: Entregar a Deus o caminho e buscar sua direção diante da incerteza.

presentations.name: Trust in God
presentations.summary: Entrusting our path to God and seeking direction amid uncertainty.

presentations.name: Buscar a Deus
presentations.summary: Voltar o coração para Deus com sinceridade e disposição para ouvi-lo.

presentations.name: Seeking God
presentations.summary: Turning toward God sincerely and with a willingness to listen.

presentations.name: Palavra de Deus
presentations.summary: Receber, meditar e praticar as Escrituras como orientação para a vida.

presentations.name: God's word
presentations.summary: Receiving, reflecting on and practicing Scripture as guidance for life.

presentations.name: Direção de Deus
presentations.summary: Buscar sabedoria para decidir e reconhecer os limites dos próprios planos.

presentations.name: God's guidance
presentations.summary: Seeking wisdom for decisions and recognizing the limits of our plans.

presentations.name: Ansiedade
presentations.summary: Levar as preocupações a Deus e aprender a viver um dia de cada vez.

presentations.name: Anxiety
presentations.summary: Bringing worries to God and learning to live one day at a time.

presentations.name: Medo
presentations.summary: Encontrar coragem e amparo em Deus em meio ao perigo e à insegurança.

presentations.name: Fear
presentations.summary: Finding courage and support in God amid danger and insecurity.

presentations.name: Sofrimento
presentations.summary: Dar espaço ao lamento e à esperança diante da dor, sem reduzir suas causas a respostas fáceis.

presentations.name: Suffering
presentations.summary: Making room for lament and hope without reducing pain to easy explanations.

presentations.name: Luto
presentations.summary: Expressar a dor da perda e acolher consolo e esperança.

presentations.name: Grief
presentations.summary: Expressing the pain of loss and receiving comfort and hope.

presentations.name: Esperança
presentations.summary: Aguardar com perseverança o cuidado e as promessas de Deus.

presentations.name: Hope
presentations.summary: Waiting with perseverance for God's care and promises.

presentations.name: Paz
presentations.summary: Buscar reconciliação e receber a paz anunciada por Jesus.

presentations.name: Peace
presentations.summary: Seeking reconciliation and receiving the peace Jesus announces.

presentations.name: Alegria
presentations.summary: Celebrar a bondade de Deus e encontrar motivos de alegria mesmo em dificuldades.

presentations.name: Joy
presentations.summary: Celebrating God's goodness and finding reasons for joy amid difficulties.

presentations.name: Solidão
presentations.summary: Expressar o sentimento de abandono e encontrar cuidado em Deus e na comunidade.

presentations.name: Loneliness
presentations.summary: Expressing abandonment and finding care in God and community.

presentations.name: Ira
presentations.summary: Reconhecer a raiva e responder sem alimentar violência e ressentimento.

presentations.name: Anger
presentations.summary: Recognizing anger and responding without feeding violence or resentment.

presentations.name: Cansaço
presentations.summary: Reconhecer os próprios limites e receber descanso e renovação.

presentations.name: Weariness
presentations.summary: Recognizing our limits and receiving rest and renewal.

presentations.name: Amor
presentations.summary: Amar a Deus e ao próximo por meio de cuidado, compromisso e serviço.

presentations.name: Love
presentations.summary: Loving God and our neighbors through care, commitment and service.

presentations.name: Perdão
presentations.summary: Receber o perdão de Deus e lidar com as ofensas sem cultivar vingança.

presentations.name: Forgiveness
presentations.summary: Receiving God's forgiveness and responding to wrongs without revenge.

presentations.name: Amizade
presentations.summary: Cultivar lealdade, presença e cuidado mútuo.

presentations.name: Friendship
presentations.summary: Cultivating loyalty, presence and mutual care.

presentations.name: Casamento
presentations.summary: Explorar o compromisso conjugal, a fidelidade e o cuidado entre os cônjuges.

presentations.name: Marriage
presentations.summary: Exploring marital commitment, faithfulness and mutual care.

presentations.name: Família
presentations.summary: Aprender sobre cuidado, responsabilidades e transmissão da fé entre gerações.

presentations.name: Family
presentations.summary: Learning about care, responsibilities and passing on faith across generations.

presentations.name: Crianças
presentations.summary: Reconhecer a dignidade das crianças e a responsabilidade de acolhê-las.

presentations.name: Children
presentations.summary: Recognizing children's dignity and the responsibility to welcome them.

presentations.name: Reconciliação
presentations.summary: Procurar restaurar relações com verdade, responsabilidade e paz.

presentations.name: Reconciliation
presentations.summary: Seeking to restore relationships with truth, responsibility and peace.

presentations.name: Hospitalidade
presentations.summary: Acolher pessoas e compartilhar a vida e os recursos disponíveis.

presentations.name: Hospitality
presentations.summary: Welcoming people and sharing life and available resources.

presentations.name: Amor aos inimigos
presentations.summary: Responder à hostilidade sem vingança e buscar o bem de quem se opõe a nós.

presentations.name: Love for enemies
presentations.summary: Responding to hostility without revenge and seeking our opponents' good.

presentations.name: Palavras e comunicação
presentations.summary: Usar a fala com verdade, cuidado e disposição para ouvir.

presentations.name: Words and communication
presentations.summary: Speaking truthfully and carefully, with a willingness to listen.

presentations.name: Sabedoria
presentations.summary: Discernir como viver, decidir e agir diante de Deus.

presentations.name: Wisdom
presentations.summary: Discerning how to live, decide and act before God.

presentations.name: Humildade
presentations.summary: Reconhecer os próprios limites e considerar o bem dos outros.

presentations.name: Humility
presentations.summary: Recognizing our limits and considering the good of others.

presentations.name: Paciência
presentations.summary: Aprender a esperar e tratar outras pessoas com perseverança e mansidão.

presentations.name: Patience
presentations.summary: Learning to wait and treat others with perseverance and gentleness.

presentations.name: Integridade
presentations.summary: Manter coerência entre palavras e ações, inclusive quando isso custa algo.

presentations.name: Integrity
presentations.summary: Keeping words and actions consistent, even when it costs something.

presentations.name: Domínio próprio
presentations.summary: Orientar desejos e reações para uma vida de responsabilidade e amor.

presentations.name: Self-control
presentations.summary: Directing desires and reactions toward responsibility and love.

presentations.name: Coragem
presentations.summary: Agir com fidelidade em situações de medo, oposição ou risco.

presentations.name: Courage
presentations.summary: Acting faithfully in situations of fear, opposition or risk.

presentations.name: Mansidão
presentations.summary: Tratar as pessoas com firmeza e cuidado, sem arrogância ou agressão.

presentations.name: Gentleness
presentations.summary: Treating people firmly and carefully, without arrogance or aggression.

presentations.name: Fidelidade
presentations.summary: Persistir no compromisso com Deus e nas responsabilidades recebidas.

presentations.name: Faithfulness
presentations.summary: Persevering in commitment to God and entrusted responsibilities.

presentations.name: Tentação
presentations.summary: Reconhecer as tentações e buscar auxílio para resistir ao mal.

presentations.name: Temptation
presentations.summary: Recognizing temptation and seeking help to resist evil.

presentations.name: Inveja
presentations.summary: Examinar a comparação e o ressentimento, cultivando contentamento e amor.

presentations.name: Envy
presentations.summary: Examining comparison and resentment while cultivating contentment and love.

presentations.name: Trabalho
presentations.summary: Realizar o trabalho com responsabilidade e considerar sua dignidade e seus limites.

presentations.name: Work
presentations.summary: Working responsibly and considering the dignity and limits of work.

presentations.name: Dinheiro
presentations.summary: Examinar a relação com os bens, a segurança financeira e o próximo.

presentations.name: Money
presentations.summary: Examining our relationship with possessions, financial security and neighbors.

presentations.name: Generosidade
presentations.summary: Compartilhar recursos com disposição, responsabilidade e atenção às necessidades.

presentations.name: Generosity
presentations.summary: Sharing resources willingly, responsibly and attentively to others' needs.

presentations.name: Justiça
presentations.summary: Agir com equidade e defender pessoas expostas à opressão e à exploração.

presentations.name: Justice
presentations.summary: Acting fairly and defending people exposed to oppression and exploitation.

presentations.name: Descanso
presentations.summary: Reservar tempo para repousar, adorar e reconhecer que a vida não se resume à produção.

presentations.name: Rest
presentations.summary: Making time to rest, worship and recognize that life is more than production.

presentations.name: Contentamento
presentations.summary: Aprender a viver sem fazer da abundância material a medida da vida.

presentations.name: Contentment
presentations.summary: Learning to live without making material abundance the measure of life.

presentations.name: Pobreza e cuidado
presentations.summary: Reconhecer necessidades materiais e agir com compaixão e justiça.

presentations.name: Poverty and care
presentations.summary: Recognizing material needs and acting with compassion and justice.

presentations.name: Administração dos recursos
presentations.summary: Cuidar dos bens, capacidades e responsabilidades que nos são confiados.

presentations.name: Stewardship
presentations.summary: Caring for the possessions, abilities and responsibilities entrusted to us.

presentations.name: Planos e decisões
presentations.summary: Planejar com prudência, humildade e atenção às consequências.

presentations.name: Plans and decisions
presentations.summary: Planning with prudence, humility and attention to consequences.

presentations.name: Cuidado com a criação
presentations.summary: Reconhecer a criação como obra de Deus e refletir sobre a responsabilidade humana.

presentations.name: Care for creation
presentations.summary: Recognizing creation as God's work and reflecting on human responsibility.

presentations.name: Graça
presentations.summary: Receber o favor de Deus como dádiva que transforma a maneira de viver.

presentations.name: Grace
presentations.summary: Receiving God's favor as a gift that transforms how we live.

presentations.name: Salvação
presentations.summary: Explorar como as Escrituras apresentam a ação de Deus para salvar e restaurar.

presentations.name: Salvation
presentations.summary: Exploring how Scripture presents God's action to save and restore.

presentations.name: Arrependimento
presentations.summary: Reconhecer o pecado e voltar-se para Deus com mudança de direção.

presentations.name: Repentance
presentations.summary: Recognizing sin and turning toward God with a change of direction.

presentations.name: Pecado
presentations.summary: Examinar a ruptura com Deus e com o próximo e a necessidade de perdão.

presentations.name: Sin
presentations.summary: Examining our broken relationship with God and neighbors and the need for forgiveness.

presentations.name: Aliança
presentations.summary: Acompanhar os compromissos e promessas de Deus ao longo da narrativa bíblica.

presentations.name: Covenant
presentations.summary: Following God's commitments and promises throughout the biblical narrative.

presentations.name: Reino de Deus
presentations.summary: Explorar o anúncio de Jesus sobre o reinado de Deus e suas implicações.

presentations.name: Kingdom of God
presentations.summary: Exploring Jesus' announcement of God's reign and its implications.

presentations.name: Espírito Santo
presentations.summary: Conhecer as passagens sobre a presença, a ação e os dons do Espírito.

presentations.name: Holy Spirit
presentations.summary: Reading passages about the Spirit's presence, work and gifts.

presentations.name: Criação
presentations.summary: Contemplar Deus como criador e o lugar da humanidade em sua obra.

presentations.name: Creation
presentations.summary: Contemplating God as creator and humanity's place in his work.

presentations.name: Redenção
presentations.summary: Acompanhar a linguagem de libertação e resgate na obra de Deus.

presentations.name: Redemption
presentations.summary: Following the language of liberation and rescue in God's work.

presentations.name: Santidade
presentations.summary: Explorar o chamado para pertencer a Deus e viver de modo coerente com esse vínculo.

presentations.name: Holiness
presentations.summary: Exploring the call to belong to God and live consistently with that relationship.

presentations.name: Serviço
presentations.summary: Colocar capacidades e recursos a serviço do próximo.

presentations.name: Service
presentations.summary: Putting abilities and resources at the service of our neighbors.

presentations.name: Unidade
presentations.summary: Cultivar comunhão sem ignorar a diversidade de dons e responsabilidades.

presentations.name: Unity
presentations.summary: Cultivating fellowship while recognizing diverse gifts and responsibilities.

presentations.name: Comunhão
presentations.summary: Compartilhar a fé, a vida e o cuidado mútuo na comunidade.

presentations.name: Fellowship
presentations.summary: Sharing faith, life and mutual care in community.

presentations.name: Missão
presentations.summary: Participar do anúncio do evangelho e do testemunho sobre Jesus.

presentations.name: Mission
presentations.summary: Participating in proclaiming the gospel and bearing witness to Jesus.

presentations.name: Dons espirituais
presentations.summary: Compreender os dons como meios de servir e edificar a comunidade.

presentations.name: Spiritual gifts
presentations.summary: Understanding gifts as ways to serve and build up the community.

presentations.name: Liderança
presentations.summary: Exercer responsabilidade sobre outras pessoas com exemplo, serviço e cuidado.

presentations.name: Leadership
presentations.summary: Taking responsibility for others through example, service and care.

presentations.name: Igreja
presentations.summary: Explorar as imagens bíblicas da comunidade reunida em torno de Cristo.

presentations.name: Church
presentations.summary: Exploring biblical images of the community gathered around Christ.

presentations.name: Batismo
presentations.summary: Ler os relatos e ensinos sobre o batismo em seus contextos.

presentations.name: Baptism
presentations.summary: Reading accounts and teachings about baptism in their contexts.

presentations.name: Ceia do Senhor
presentations.summary: Recordar a entrega de Jesus e refletir sobre comunhão e responsabilidade à mesa.

presentations.name: Lord's Supper
presentations.summary: Remembering Jesus' self-giving and reflecting on fellowship and responsibility at the table.

presentations.name: Cuidado mútuo
presentations.summary: Sustentar uns aos outros com presença, encorajamento e ajuda concreta.

presentations.name: Mutual care
presentations.summary: Supporting one another through presence, encouragement and practical help.

presentations.name: Ressurreição
presentations.summary: Explorar o testemunho sobre a ressurreição de Jesus e a esperança que ela fundamenta.

presentations.name: Resurrection
presentations.summary: Exploring testimony about Jesus' resurrection and the hope it grounds.

presentations.name: Vida eterna
presentations.summary: Ler o ensino de Jesus sobre a vida recebida de Deus.

presentations.name: Eternal life
presentations.summary: Reading Jesus' teaching about life received from God.

presentations.name: Morte
presentations.summary: Encarar a finitude humana e as promessas de Deus diante da morte.

presentations.name: Death
presentations.summary: Facing human mortality and God's promises in the face of death.

presentations.name: Juízo
presentations.summary: Refletir sobre responsabilidade, justiça e prestação de contas diante de Deus.

presentations.name: Judgment
presentations.summary: Reflecting on responsibility, justice and accountability before God.

presentations.name: Volta de Cristo
presentations.summary: Explorar as promessas da volta de Jesus e o chamado à vigilância.

presentations.name: Return of Christ
presentations.summary: Exploring promises of Jesus' return and the call to watchfulness.

presentations.name: Nova criação
presentations.summary: Conhecer as imagens bíblicas de renovação, restauração e presença de Deus.

presentations.name: New creation
presentations.summary: Discovering biblical images of renewal, restoration and God's presence.

presentations.name: Vigilância
presentations.summary: Viver com atenção e fidelidade enquanto se aguarda o cumprimento das promessas.

presentations.name: Watchfulness
presentations.summary: Living attentively and faithfully while awaiting God's promises.

presentations.name: Perseverança
presentations.summary: Prosseguir na fé diante das dificuldades, sustentado pela esperança.

presentations.name: Perseverance
presentations.summary: Continuing in faith through difficulty, sustained by hope.

presentations.name: Herança em Cristo
presentations.summary: Explorar a linguagem de herança e pertencimento nas promessas de Deus.

presentations.name: Inheritance in Christ
presentations.summary: Exploring the language of inheritance and belonging in God's promises.

presentations.name: Deus conosco
presentations.summary: Acompanhar a promessa da presença de Deus com seu povo.

presentations.name: God with us
presentations.summary: Following the promise of God's presence with his people.
